ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There is a north-south direction marker in the figure, and the horizontal line represents the ground; the flagpoles of cities a and b are of equal height. The legend shows that black represents the shadow length on June 22, and white represents the shadow length on December 22. In the figure, the black June 22 shadow length at place a is 0. Reasoning: The pole shadow length at place a being 0 corresponds to June 22, that is, the Northern Hemisphere summer solstice. Beijing and Guangzhou are both located in the Northern Hemisphere. On the summer solstice, in the Northern Hemisphere, the higher the latitude, the longer the daytime; Beijing's latitude is higher than Guangzhou's, so Beijing's daytime is longer than Guangzhou's.
